description: This file defines a PHP class 'Forgotten' within the 'Opencart\Admin\Controller\Mail' namespace. The class is a controller that handles email-related operations for password reset functionality in the OpenCart admin panel. It contains at least an 'index' method that processes requests to send password reset emails, including loading language files, preparing email data, and sending email messages. The file appears to be part of the server-side codebase of the OpenCart e-commerce platform related to password recovery via email.

classes.name: Forgotten
classes.description: A controller class responsible for handling password forgotten email operations in the OpenCart admin backend. It extends the system controller and contains methods to process email sending for password reset.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Handles the process of sending a password reset email to the user. It retrieves route, email, and code parameters from the request or arguments, validates the email, loads language and configuration settings, composes email content, and sends the email if conditions are met.
